source: Year 1 from the CCMAS B.Sc. Microbiology at UNIOSUN; years 2-4 from the UNIOSUN B.Sc. Microbiology course structure (uniosun.edu.ng, April 2026), which is not labelled CCMAS. Cross-check Unilorin (microbiology.lifesciences.unilorin.edu.ng) for the alternative scheme.

courses.name: General Biology I
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology I: Cell Biology and Diversity of Life
courses.summary: Cell structure and function, biomolecules, genetics and heredity, evolution and the classification of living organisms.

courses.name: General Biology II
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology II: Physiology and Ecology
courses.summary: Plant and animal physiology, reproduction, ecology, ecosystems and environmental biology.

courses.name: General Practical Biology I
courses.summary: Microscopy, cell and tissue observation, dissections and basic biological techniques with drawings.

courses.name: General Practical Biology II
courses.summary: Practicals on plant and animal physiology, ecology sampling and identification.

courses.name: General Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Atomic Structure, Bonding and Physical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Atomic structure, periodic table, bonding, stoichiometry, states of matter, gas laws, thermochemistry and chemical equilibrium.

courses.name: General Chemistry II
courses.summary: Kinetics, electrochemistry, acids and bases, periodic trends, main-group chemistry, and introduction to organic compounds and reactions.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Safe lab practice, volumetric analysis, titrations, qualitative tests and simple physical-chemistry experiments.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry II
courses.summary: Qualitative inorganic analysis, organic functional-group tests, kinetics and electrochemistry experiments.

courses.name: Introduction to Computing Sciences
courses.general_name: Introduction to Computer Science and Information Technology
courses.summary: History and generations of computers, hardware, software, operating systems, networks, number systems and the Internet, with productivity tools.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: Introduction to Microbiology
courses.summary: History, microbial diversity, bacteria, viruses, fungi, protozoa, sterilisation, culture and microbes in health and industry.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics I
courses.general_name: Pre-calculus: Algebra, Trigonometry and Coordinate Geometry
courses.summary: Sets, number systems, polynomials, inequalities, functions, logarithms, trigonometry, complex numbers and sequences.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics II
courses.summary: Limits, continuity, differentiation, applications of derivatives, integration, areas and volumes, and basic differential equations.

courses.name: General Physics I
courses.general_name: Introductory Mechanics and Properties of Matter
courses.summary: Units and dimensions, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion, gravitation, elasticity and fluids.

courses.name: General Physics II
courses.summary: Electric fields, potential, capacitance, DC circuits, magnetism, induction, AC basics, then waves and optics.

courses.name: General Practical Physics I
courses.summary: Measurement, error analysis and experiments in mechanics, heat and properties of matter, with report writing.

courses.name: General Practical Physics II
courses.summary: Experiments in electricity, magnetism, optics and waves, with graph work and error analysis.

courses.name: General Biochemistry I
courses.general_name: Introductory Biochemistry I: Biomolecules and Enzymes
courses.summary: Structure and function of carbohydrates, lipids, amino acids, proteins and nucleic acids, plus enzyme basics.

courses.name: General Biochemistry II
courses.summary: Bioenergetics, glycolysis, TCA cycle, oxidative phosphorylation, lipid and amino-acid metabolism.

courses.name: General Ecology
courses.summary: Ecosystems, populations, communities and energy flow.

courses.name: Biological Techniques
courses.summary: Microscopy, staining, sampling and lab techniques.

courses.name: General Physiology
courses.summary: Cell physiology, membranes, body fluids, homeostasis, excitable tissues, muscle and transport.

courses.name: Introductory Genetics and Cell Biology
courses.summary: Cell structure, division, inheritance and genetics.

courses.name: Organic Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Introductory Organic Chemistry: Structure, Bonding and Reactions
courses.summary: Hydrocarbons, alkyl halides, alcohols, stereochemistry, reaction mechanisms and functional groups.

courses.name: Physical Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Physical Chemistry I: Thermodynamics and Kinetics
courses.summary: Gas laws, thermodynamics, thermochemistry, chemical equilibrium and reaction rates.

courses.name: Inorganic Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Inorganic Chemistry I: Structure and Periodicity
courses.summary: Atomic and molecular structure, periodic trends, bonding theories and chemistry of main-group elements.

courses.name: Experimental Physical and Inorganic Chemistry
courses.summary: Lab work: thermochemistry, kinetics and inorganic analysis.

courses.name: Experimental Physical and Organic Chemistry
courses.summary: Lab work: organic synthesis and physical measurements.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: General Microbiology I
courses.summary: Microbial diversity, bacterial structure and growth.

courses.name: General Microbiology II
courses.summary: Microbial metabolism, genetics and control.

courses.name: Introductory Virology
courses.summary: Virus structure, replication and diseases.

courses.name: Introduction to Food Science
courses.summary: Food composition, processing and preservation.

courses.name: Statistics for Agricultural and Biological Sciences Students
courses.general_name: Statistics for Agricultural and Biological Sciences Students
courses.summary: Statistical analysis for biological experiments.

courses.name: Invertebrate Zoology
courses.summary: Classification and biology of invertebrates.

courses.name: Introduction to Biotechnology
courses.summary: Principles and applications of biotechnology.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Bacteriology
courses.summary: Bacterial structure, genetics and pathogenic species.

courses.name: Soil Microbiology
courses.summary: Soil microbes, nutrient cycles and biofertilisers.

courses.name: Microbial Genetics and Molecular Biology
courses.summary: Bacterial and viral genetics, gene transfer, mutation, gene regulation and recombinant DNA techniques.

courses.name: Mycology
courses.summary: Fungal biology, classification and mycoses.

courses.name: Food Microbiology
courses.summary: Spoilage, food-borne disease and preservation.

courses.name: Microbial Ecology
courses.summary: Microbes in habitats and interactions.

courses.name: SIWES (Student Industrial Work Experience Scheme)
courses.summary: Supervised industrial placement with logbook and report.

courses.name: Parasitology I
courses.summary: Protozoan and helminth parasites.

courses.name: Immunology and Immunochemistry
courses.summary: Innate and adaptive immunity, antigens, antibodies, hypersensitivity, autoimmunity, vaccines and immunoassays.

courses.name: Virology and Tissue Culture
courses.summary: Virology methods and cell culture.

courses.name: Principles of Epidemiology and Public Health
courses.general_name: Principles of Epidemiology and Public Health
courses.summary: Disease patterns, outbreak methods and public-health basics.

courses.name: Industrial Microbiology
courses.summary: Fermentation, industrial strains and production.

courses.name: Pharmaceutical Microbiology
courses.summary: Sterility, antibiotics and pharmaceutical quality.

courses.name: Petroleum Microbiology
courses.summary: Hydrocarbon-degrading microbes and bioremediation.

courses.name: Pathogenic Microbiology
courses.summary: Medically important pathogens and diagnosis.

courses.name: Microbial Physiology and Metabolism
courses.summary: Microbial growth, energy and metabolic pathways.

courses.name: Environmental Microbiology
courses.summary: Microbes in water, soil and waste.

courses.name: Biodeterioration
courses.summary: Microbial damage to materials.

courses.name: Microbiological Quality Assurance
courses.summary: Quality systems, standards and testing.

courses.name: Seminar Presentation
courses.summary: Researching and presenting a microbiology topic.

courses.name: Research Project
courses.summary: Independent supervised research with data collection, analysis, thesis and defence.
